title: This fixes the d/watch so uscan can grab the tarball.
description:
This fixes the d/watch so uscan can grab the tarball.

Originally:
uscan --download-current-version
uscan warn: In debian/watch no matching hrefs for version 3.8.3 in watch line
  https://api.github.com/repos/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/releases?per_page=100&page=2 https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/releases/download/[^/]+/rabbitmq-server-(?:[-_]?[Vv]?(\d[\-+\.:\~\da-zA-Z]*))(?i)(?:\.(?:tar\.xz|tar\.bz2|tar\.gz|tar\.zstd?|zip|tgz|tbz|txz))
 ✘ mitch@light  ~/git/rabbitmq-server/rabbitmq-server   mitch/rmq-focal-fix-d-watch

Now:
uscan --download-current-version
Newest version of rabbitmq-server on remote site is 3.8.3, specified download version is 3.8.3
gpgv: Signature made Mon 09 Mar 2020 07:52:21 AM MST
gpgv:                using RSA key 0A9AF2115F4687BD29803A206B73A36E6026DFCA
gpgv: Good signature from "RabbitMQ Release Signing Key <email address hidden>"
Successfully symlinked ../rabbitmq-server-3.8.3.tar.xz to ../rabbitmq-server_3.8.3.orig.tar.xz.
 mitch@light  ~/git/rabbitmq-server/rabbitmq-server   mitch/rmq-focal-fix-d-watch
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 39147e9..a1f2b2b 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+rabbitmq-server (3.8.3-0ubuntu0.2) focal; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/watch: update to view page 3 instead of 2
+
+ -- Mitchell Dzurick <mitchell.dzurick@canonical.com>  Mon, 14 Oct 2024 16:52:26 -0700
+
 rabbitmq-server (3.8.3-0ubuntu0.1) focal; urgency=medium
 
   * New upstream verison 3.8.3 (LP: #2060248).
diff --git a/debian/watch b/debian/watch
index 747a68e..fb7c477 100644
--- a/debian/watch
+++ b/debian/watch
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 version=4
 opts="searchmode=plain,pgpmode=auto" \
-  https://api.github.com/repos/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/releases?per_page=100&page=2 \
+  https://api.github.com/repos/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/releases?per_page=100&page=3 \
   https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/releases/download/[^/]+/@PACKAGE@-@ANY_VERSION@@ARCHIVE_EXT@
